I recently hired SparkleClean Pros to deep-clean my two-bedroom apartment after a hectic move, and wow, they totally delivered! I've used other cleaning services before, but these folks were on another level. The team showed up right on time, introduced themselves politely, and got straight to work without any fuss. They tackled everything from the dusty baseboards to the grimy oven—stuff I hadn't even thought about.

What impressed me most was how thorough they were with the details. My bathroom sparkled like new (pun intended), and they even organized my cluttered kitchen cabinets without me asking. No harsh chemicals lingering in the air either; everything smelled fresh and natural. Pricing was fair too—about $150 for the full job, which felt like a steal compared to competitors.

One tiny hiccup: they missed a spot under the fridge, but when I mentioned it later, the owner sent someone back the next day for free. That kind of follow-up builds real trust. If you're drowning in mess like I was, definitely give SparkleClean a shot. Five stars from this busy single dad—highly recommend!
